A LITTLE HELP ALONG THE WAY

How to use this worksheet.

Choose your preferred settings, check the live preview, and download the ready-to-print A4 worksheet. Every sheet is created right inside your browser.

  1. Begin with a short practice session.
  2. Let children trace slowly before writing on their own.
  3. Print another version whenever you want more practice.

Practice the vowel sounds

Marathi स्वर such as अ, आ, इ, ई, उ and ऊ are independent vowel characters. Compare each printed vowel carefully before tracing it and saying its sound aloud.

♧
Friendly printing tip

For the clearest worksheet, use A4 paper, 100% scale, and standard or high print quality.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few helpful answers.

Is this worksheet free?＋

Yes. You can customize, download, and print this worksheet for free, for home and classroom use.

Do I need an account?＋

No account is needed. The worksheet is generated on your device without uploading children’s names or practice text.

Can I print on A4 paper?＋

Yes. Downloads are A4 portrait PDFs. Print at actual size or 100% scale for the best layout.
